title: The Life and Perambulations of a Mouse
sourceTitle: The Life and Perambulations of a Mouse
author: Dorothy Kilner
description: "The Life and Perambulations of a Mouse" by Dorothy Kilner is a children's novel written during the late 18th century.
longDescription: The story follows a mouse, referred to as Nimble, who narrates his adventures and misadventures in a world filled with human dangers and insights.

authorInfo.bio: Dorothy Kilner (1755–1836) wrote The Life and Perambulations of a Mouse. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
